sources.summary: A mountain house that blurs the boundaries between living and contemplating. Sited on a plateau, between rolling lawns and the forest that climbs up the slope, the house sits as if it has belonged to the landscape for a long time. The horizontal, discreet, and elongated volume follows the natural slope of the ground — and it is precisely this simple decision that organizes the entire experience of the project: living close to the earth, yet suspended above it.
